jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Applied Research
jobs.description:
**Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!**
---------------------------------------------

Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.

As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.

We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.

**Role**
--------

* Lead research projects across the marketplace dynamics problem area: simulation, auction and allocation mechanics, long-term objective modeling, exploration and information value, or marketplace experimentation methods
* Take ideas from hypothesis to production: literature review, prototyping, offline validation, shadow testing, and online experiments shipped through partner teams in Discovery and the Seller org
* Build models of how the marketplace behaves as a system: learned simulators that predict segment-level effects of ranking and policy changes, and surrogate models of long-term marketplace outcomes
* Model Whatnot's actual market mechanics: auction and bidding dynamics, and discovery exposure allocation as a portfolio problem, including allocation to rising sellers
* Advance how a multi-sided live marketplace evaluates changes: off-policy evaluation, switchback and interference-robust experiment designs, and variance reduction
* Contribute to Whatnot's external technical presence through publications, open-source work, and public benchmarks

**You**
-------

Curious about who thrives at Whatnot? We’ve found that embodying a low ego, growth mindset, and high-impact drive goes a long way here. As our next Machine Learning Engineer you should have:

* 5+ years of industry experience building and deploying ML models to solve user problems at scale
* Depth in at least one of: recommendation systems, causal inference, off-policy evaluation, reinforcement learning and bandits, auction or mechanism design, or marketplace experimentation
* A track record of applying scientific methods to solve real-world problems on consumer-scale data
* Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL, and common ML frameworks like PyTorch, XGBoost, etc
* Strong grounding in applied statistics, experiment design and theoretical machine learning
* Strong communication and leadership skills; ability to influence roadmaps and align cross-functional teams in a remote environment
* Preferred Qualifications:

  + Experience in two-sided marketplaces, ads and auction systems, or pricing
  + Experience building simulators or economic models of platform behavior

**Compensation**
----------------

**For Full-Time (Salary) US-based applicants:** $210,000k/year to $300,000k/year + benefits + equity.

The salary range may be inclusive of several levels that would be applicable to the position. Final salary will be based on a number of factors including, level, relevant prior experience, skills, and expertise. This range is only inclusive of base salary, not benefits (more details below) or equity.

**Benefits**
------------

* Flexible Time off Policy and Company-wide Holidays (including a spring and winter break)
* Health Insurance options including Medical, Dental, Vision
* Work From Home Support

  + Home office setup allowance
  + Monthly allowance for cell phone and internet
* Care benefits

  + Monthly allowance for wellness
  + Annual allowance towards Childcare
  + Lifetime benefit for family planning, such as adoption or fertility expenses
* Retirement; 401k offering for Traditional and Roth accounts in the US (employer match up to 4% of base salary) and Pension plans internationally
* Monthly allowance to dogfood the app
* Parental Leave

  + 16 weeks of paid parental leave + one month gradual return to work \*company leave allowances run concurrently with country leave requirements which take precedence.

**Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. If you see an email impersonating a Whatnot recruiter, please disregard and report it as spam.**

**EOE**
-------

Whatnot is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce.

Compensation Range: $210K - $300K

jobs.title: CV & ML Engineer
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
The Video Computer Vision organization is working on exciting technologies for future Apple products. Our team delivers computer vision and machine learning algorithms that power many Apple technologies like human understanding and human intelligence algorithms with applications for digital humans, health and AI. In this role, you will work closely with our team of experts in computer graphics, computer vision and machine learning to design and build solutions to previously unsolved challenges for Apple products and bring high impact to millions of users.
  
  
Description
  
  
You will work closely with Multimodal GenAI researchers and engineers to develop world-class audio-video perception and representation algorithms. The role focuses on building, integrating and maintaining complex real-time systems within a large production software stack. Deep understanding of machine learning inference, on-device performance optimization and low-level systems programming is highly desirable. As a member of a fast-paced team, you have the unique and rewarding opportunity to shape upcoming products that will delight and inspire millions of people every day. The ideal candidate should possess these qualities: \* Be highly-motivated and take initiative to achieve goals, while delivering on schedule. \* Has a sense of curiosity and willingness to learn new things in order to improve the quality of their solutions. \* Works well in a collaborative setting.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Vision, Computer Graphics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related fields.
* 5+ years of relevant industry experience.
* Strong proficiency in C++ and Objective-C/C++, writing clean and well-structured code.
* Experience building concurrent, real-time systems: threads, synchronization and asynchronous processing.
* Experience profiling and optimizing performance-critical code or ML inference on device.
* Solid mathematical foundation in linear algebra and numerical analysis.
* Experience breaking down large problems and delivering robust solutions.
* Experience developing user-facing APIs for complex systems.
* Curiosity about new technologies and flexibility to work across different layers of the software stack.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* MS/PhD with relevant industry experience.
* Experience with audio, computer vision, 3D graphics and animation algorithms.
* Low-level optimization experience, such as deploying algorithms to GPUs or other hardware accelerators, or GPU programming with Metal, Vulkan or CUDA.
* Understanding of SW/HW parallelism, threads, processes and asynchronous processing.
* Experience with on-device inference frameworks such as Core ML, MLX or ExecuTorch, or with LLM inference systems such as vLLM or SGLang.
* Knowledge of diffusion transformer models especially in context of on-device inference.
* Experience developing and integrating agentic workflow frameworks with tool calling components.
* Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code or Codex, including the judgment to review and validate generated code.

  
  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $184,700 and $324,800, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

We seek to promote equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. Learn more about your EEO rights as an applicant

  
  
  

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re hiring Research Engineers to join teams across Meta working at the intersection of frontier AI and real-world product impact. You’ll be embedded directly in Facebook’s ecosystem, helping reimagine core experiences and reshape how people discover content, connect with creators, and interact with each other.The work spans some of the most bold bets in applied GenAI, including:- Building the post-training, evaluation, and serving systems that turn frontier LLMs into reliable, high-quality product experiences used by billions.- Building a general-purpose agentic platform that powers a wide range of GenAI products across Facebook —enabling teams to ship faster, safer, and at scale.- Building systems that enable capacity and cost optimizations through model fine-tuning, post-training and other techniques. - Adapting and scaling these systems across Meta’s products. Why Join Us- Product LLM work at singular scale Your post-training decisions, evaluation frameworks, and serving architecture directly affect billions of daily interactions.- End-to-end ownership We don't hand off models to a separate product team. We own the loop from training data to production behavior to measurement. The impact of your work shows up in days, not quarters.- The problems are unsolved How do you evaluate open-ended conversational AI at scale? How do you fine-tune for groundedness across millions of varied creator profiles? These aren't incremental improvements, they're open research questions with immediate product consequences.- Our team is hands-on, with high autonomy, working on critical bets We're deliberately keeping this team lean and experienced. You'll have outsized influence on technical direction, not just execution.Depending on your interests and strengths, your work could span post-training pipelines (SFT, RLHF, synthetic data generation), evaluation methodology (auto-judge design, benchmark construction, human-AI calibration), production serving systems (RAG, memory, multi-modal generation), multi-agent orchestration, or E2E experience of building agentic products, - all grounded in shipping to real users at scale  
  
  

### **AI Research Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Contribute to the training of next-generation multimodal foundation models, advance their capabilities in understanding, generation, and grounding, and enable them for downstream product use-cases
* Support creative data sourcing, high-quality pre/mid/post-training data curation, and scale and optimize data pipelines for multimodal large language models (LLMs)
* Lead, collaborate, and execute on research that pushes forward the state of the art in multimodal reasoning and generation research, and prioritize research that can be directly applied to Meta’s product development

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Experience as a formal technical lead, leading major technical initiatives with XFN impact, and/or influencing strategy across multiple teams
* Impressive engineering background (PhD in ML not required)
* Experience working in AI/ML environments
* Can manage data pipelines and versioning

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Apple Ads
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Apple is where we use the power of technology to enrich people's lives. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It's the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you'll do more than join something — you'll add something. Join the Apple Ads Engineering team and help build an advertising platform that benefits both customers and advertisers. Our technology makes advertising possible on the App Store, Apple News, Stocks, and Apple TV — helping people discover content, supporting creators and publishers, and connecting advertisers of all sizes with engaged audiences, all with the unwavering commitment to privacy you expect from Apple. In this role, you will design, develop, and launch the highly-performant, internet-scale backend systems that select and deliver the right ads in real time, collaborating across engineering, product, and infrastructure to bring elegant solutions into production at Apple scale.
  
  
Description
  
  
You will design, develop, and operate the distributed services that make real-time ad selection possible at Apple. You will architect and build low-latency, high-availability, high-throughput ad-serving systems in a cloud environment, engineer secure and scalable data processing pipelines that operate on petabyte-scale datasets, and implement performant services that handle very high data volumes and QPS. You will work cross-functionally to ensure that optimal and correct ads are available for real-time selection, and that observability and flexibility are provided for stakeholders. While this role focuses on the candidate retrieval part of Apple Ads, we are not constrained by organization structure and offer the flexibility to contribute across a variety of backend systems, including opportunities to apply algorithmic search, machine learning, NLP, and AI to hard retrieval problems. You will write clean, efficient, well-documented code, participate in code reviews, and mentor other engineers on the team. Collaboration with internal partners across indexing, search, serving, operations, and program management to define requirements and deliver high-quality solutions is essential. You should be passionate about building products that protect user privacy and thrive in a fast-paced environment with rapidly changing priorities — and have fun doing it.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 3+ years of industry experience architecting and developing internet-scale server software for Linux systems, including scalable micro-services or data-driven platforms.
* Strong background in computer science fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures.
* Strong coding skills in Go, Java, Rust, C++, Scala, or a similar OOP/Functional language.
* Hands-on experience designing and operating scalable micro-services.
* Experience with search technologies such as Lucene, Solr, or Elasticsearch. Expertise with NoSQL datastores (e.g., Cassandra).
* Proficiency with data processing technologies (e.g., Kafka, Spark, Flink) and methods for processing petabyte-scale datasets.
* Experience with AWS services such as Amazon S3, EC2, and EKS/Kubernetes. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work on complex problems and systems, alone or as part of a team, to deliver complete systems end to end.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical cross-functional teams, including operations and project management partners.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Experience creating groundbreaking technology for algorithmic search, machine learning, natural language processing, and artificial intelligence.
* Experience building ad-serving, recommendation, or large-scale retrieval systems.
* Familiarity with real-time bidding, candidate retrieval, or ranking pipelines.
* Experience operating services with strict latency and availability SLOs.
* Familiarity with privacy-preserving system design and data-handling practices.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals — consensus, replication, and fault tolerance.
* A desire to work in a fast-paced and challenging environment, and a fast learner with strong motivation for growing and learning new technologies.

  
  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

jobs.title: Applied Scientist, Search Ranking and Exploration
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's Search team creates ML algorithms that connect customers around the world with products that delight them. We harness machine learning at Amazon's scale to make the customer experience easier and smoother. Our impact is large. For example, if your innovations save even 1 minute per customer per year, then for every 100 million customers, you save approximately 190 years of human effort.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As an Applied Scientist on the Search L1 Ranking team, you will build search ranking models that work for thousands of product types, billions of queries, and hundreds of millions of customers spread around the world. You will find the next set of big improvements to ranking, leverage large datasets to understand the complexities of customer behavior, and build ML models that work at Amazon scale. Amazon's Search ranking relies on efficient early stage ranking followed by power final stage ranking models. this role focuses on efficient models for early stage ranking phase, and techniques to personalize these models and optimize them automatically.  
  
A day in the life  
Our primary focus is improving search ranking systems. On a day-to-day this means building ML models, analyzing data from your recent A/B tests, and collaborating with partner teams on joint goals. We leverage agentic workflows to improve our scientific velocity, and partner closely with SDEs to bring our ideas to production. You will shape the future of search ranking by presenting proposals to Amazon's business and tech leaders.  
  
About the team  
We are a team consisting of ML scientists and software engineers. Our interests span machine learned ranking models, distilled LLMs for efficient inference, personalization techniques to refine the ranking of our models, reinforcement learning to bring the benefits of exploration to search ranking, and infrastructure to make it all happen at scale and efficiently.

* PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Product - Ads Infra and Ranking
jobs.description:
Meta's Ads organization builds the systems that help businesses of every size reach the people most likely to care about what they offer. At our core, we're builders who care about shipping real value. We are seeking a hands-on [Research Engineer/Research Scientist] with expertise in world modeling, video generation, predictive modeling, or learned simulation. You will develop models that generate environments and future observations, capture temporal dynamics, and respond to actions or interventions.

You will own research problems from hypothesis and implementation through training, evaluation, and failure analysis. Working with colleagues across modeling, data, evaluation, and infrastructure, you will translate research ideas into working models and measurable improvements.

**About the Team**
------------------

Our team has a background in autonomous driving, where understanding dynamic scenes, anticipating interactions, and evaluating the consequences of actions are central challenges. This experience shapes our research into how models can learn to represent, generate, and predict the physical world.

Building on this foundation, we develop learned world models for world generation, future prediction, and simulation. Our work combines video generation with representations of scene structure, motion, and interactions to model how environments evolve under different actions and conditions. We aim to create controllable, coherent simulations that support autonomous driving research and development.

Our research spans model architecture, training methods, data, and evaluation, with a focus on long-horizon consistency, multi-view coherence, and physically plausible dynamics. We bring together modeling and engineering to turn new ideas into working systems and measurable advances in both visual quality and predictive behavior.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Research, develop, and adapt models for world generation, future prediction, and simulation.
* Advance model capabilities in controllability, consistency, and realistic world dynamics.
* Develop scalable and efficient training and inference systems for world models.
* Improve data and evaluation methods to support model quality and generalization.
* Design experiments, analyze model behavior, and use findings to guide further research.
* Collaborate across research and engineering to turn new ideas into reliable implementations and share technical findings.

 **Requirements**  

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong programming skills in Python and practical experience with PyTorch.
* Hands-on experience developing and training models in one or more of world modeling, video generation, spatiotemporal prediction, or learned simulation.
* A solid foundation in deep learning and generative or predictive modeling, with the ability to implement and evaluate research ideas.
* Experience with large-scale model training or inference and distributed machine-learning systems.
* Ability to design rigorous experiments, analyze results, and draw sound technical conclusions.
* Strong software-engineering practices, clear technical communication, and collaborative problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage:

* Research in controllable generation, long-horizon prediction, or interactive simulation.
* Fine-tuning, adaptation, or extension of advanced pretrained video generation and world models, including Cosmos, Wan, LingBot, or comparable models.
* Methods for improving model quality, efficiency, or scalability, including adaptation and distillation.
* Research contributions demonstrated through publications, open-source work, or industry projects.
* Application experience in robotics, embodied AI, autonomous driving, or other simulation domains.

You will work on problems spanning predictive modeling, natural language processing, recommendation systems, personalization, generative AI, and causal evaluation. These solutions will predict workforce outcomes, identify individual and organizational needs, recommend targeted actions, and measure the causal impact of programs, products, and policies across diverse employee populations and business contexts.  
  
As an Applied Scientist, you will develop models and algorithms from prototype through production. You will collaborate with other scientists and economists to combine machine learning with causal inference and experimentation, allowing teams to understand both what is likely to happen and which actions will improve outcomes. You will also work with product managers, engineers, and business partners to translate business needs into technical solutions and communicate methods and results to technical and nontechnical audiences.

You will design the memory and retrieval systems that let agents reason over long horizons, learn from past interactions, and take reliable action. This is a hands-on role for someone who pairs research with the engineering discipline to turn ideas into working systems.
  
If you want to shape the foundations of how agents remember, retrieve, plan, and act, and you enjoy the ambiguity of 0→1 work, this role is for you.

Build and optimize retrieval systems, including hybrid search, embedding and reranking pipelines, knowledge graphs, and retrieval over structured and unstructured data.

Define evaluation methodologies for agent, memory, and retrieval quality, including benchmarks, LLM-as-a-judge approaches, offline and online metrics, and regression testing.

jobs.title: Data & Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
### **About Mecka AI**

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.  
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.  
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

**The role**

Every hour our operators work produces hours of synchronized video, robot state, and actions, and that data is a core product. You'll own the path from robot site to a searchable, trustworthy dataset that our researchers train on and our customers buy. You'll also run the infrastructure that keeps a growing, geographically spread fleet updated, monitored, and healthy.

**What you'll do**

* Own data storage and lifecycle: ingest from sites, object storage layout, retention, tiering, and cost.
* Build the catalog: episode metadata, task labels, operator and robot info, quality flags, and search, so anyone can find "all successful pick-and-place episodes on arm model X last month."
* Build automated quality checks: dropped frames, sync drift, missing streams, failed or truncated episodes.
* Build dataset export and delivery: convert raw episodes into the formats training teams and customers expect, with versioning and provenance.
* Handle data governance: access control, customer and site data agreements, privacy (faces, sensitive scenes on site), and audit trails for data we sell.
* Run fleet infrastructure: provisioning edge machines at sites, remote software deploys and rollbacks, secrets, VPN/connectivity, monitoring, and alerting.
* Keep cloud costs and bandwidth under control as data volume grows.
* Build dashboards to monitor data collection status and progress

**What we're looking for**

* 3-4 years as a data, platform, or infrastructure engineer owning production systems end to end.
* Experience with large unstructured data (video, sensor logs, images) in object storage, not only tabular warehouses.
* Strong Python and SQL; comfortable with infrastructure-as-code, containers, and CI/CD.
* You've built pipelines with real failure handling: retries, idempotency, backfills, and monitoring.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with robotics or autonomous-vehicle data, or ML training data pipelines.
* Edge fleet management: deploying to many remote Linux devices on unreliable networks.
* Experience packaging and delivering datasets to external customers.
* Familiarity with data privacy rules across multiple countries.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, we will partner with you to meet your needs.

We may use AI-assisted tools to help evaluate applications against the requirements of this role. These tools support our recruiting team in identifying qualified candidates but do not replace human judgment or limit which applications may be reviewed or considered.

Compensation Range: CA$140K - CA$165K

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Advertising is seeking a Data Scientist II to help measure and improve one of the world's largest advertising identity platforms. You will work with massive datasets to uncover insights that directly influence how Amazon recognizes customers, connects identity signals, and enables advertisers to reach and measure audiences across the global advertising ecosystem.  
  
The Amazon Advertising Identity Platform (AIP) powers identity resolution across Amazon's owned and operated properties, third party publishers, and the open internet. As traditional identity signals become less available and consumer behavior spans more devices and environments, understanding the accuracy, coverage, and business impact of identity resolution has become increasingly important.  
  
As a Data Scientist II, you will develop analytical frameworks, measurement methodologies, and data driven insights to evaluate the performance of Amazon's identity graph. You will work with billions of identity signals to quantify recognition rates, graph coverage, identity accuracy, and the incremental value of deterministic and probabilistic identity resolution. Your analysis will help identify opportunities to improve advertising addressability, audience reach, campaign measurement, and revenue.  
  
You will design experiments, develop statistical models, and establish measurement frameworks to understand how identity improvements translate into better advertising outcomes. This includes evaluating the precision and recall of identity models, measuring the incremental contribution of individual identity sources, identifying gaps in identity coverage, and quantifying the commercial impact of identity investments.  
  
You will partner closely with applied scientists, software engineers, product managers, and business leaders to translate complex data into actionable recommendations. Your work will help shape technical priorities, guide investment decisions, and establish the metrics used to evaluate identity performance across Amazon Advertising.  
  
The ideal candidate has strong expertise in SQL, Python, statistical analysis, experimentation, and large scale data analytics. You should be comfortable working with complex datasets, developing rigorous measurement methodologies, and communicating findings to both technical and business audiences.  
  
This role offers the opportunity to establish how Amazon measures identity quality and business impact, influence the direction of a critical advertising platform, and apply data science to problems operating at global scale.

* 3+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Marketplace Economics
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We're on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you'll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower a global community of creators and developers to build immersive experiences and a dynamic virtual economy. Our Data Science organization sits at the heart of this mission, delivering the strategic and causal insights that power pricing, market health, and creator success across all Economy surfaces.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to lead the methodological and strategic foundations for our Creator Economics systems. Roblox operates multiple two-sided marketplaces, from the Avatar Marketplace to in-experience economies. You will build the economic systems and measurement frameworks that inform how value flows through the platform, such as building price optimization systems, designing new rev-share models, and establishing the economics for new UGC category launches. You will serve as a technical leader driving the roadmap for our most critical developer and creator touchpoints.

Why Marketplace Economics?

* **Real-world scale:** Power millions of daily economic interactions across a complex, two-sided marketplace where millions of creators meet over 100 million daily active users.
* **Complex markets, rich signals:** Design economic systems and measurement frameworks that account for the nuances of a two-sided marketplace, social network effects, long-term user attachment, and supply response.
* **Strategic ownership:** Lead projects from scratch, translating ambiguous business and policy questions into rigorous quantitative frameworks that directly influence high-stakes company decisions on the economics of our Marketplace.
* **Impact meets innovation:** Partner with Product and Engineering to shape the future of the Roblox economy, building measurement solutions that optimize for long-term ecosystem health and growth.

You will:

* **Design Economic Systems**: Drive the structural design of creator and curator incentives, including formulating revenue-share models that foster a thriving, balanced ecosystem.
* **Master Pricing & Supply Response**: Architect models that evaluate price elasticity, marketplace clearing rates, and predict how creators (supply) respond to pricing shifts and new economic policies.
* **Spearhead UGC Category Launches**: Lead the quantitative strategy for introducing new User-Generated Content (UGC) categories, establishing the foundational economics and incentive structures needed to spark market liquidity.
* **Apply Deep Causal Inference**: Build rigorous observational and experimental causal inference solutions to isolate the true impact of market interventions on creator success and platform economics.
* **Drive Strategy**: Partner with product and engineering leaders as a primary scientific advocate, providing unbiased measurement and insights to accelerate innovation and strategic prioritization.

You have (at least some of) the following:

* **6+ years** of industry or research experience in Data Science or Economics, specifically within large-scale UGC content platforms, pricing, marketplace mechanism design, or creator economies.
* **Deep Methodological Expertise** in quantitative methodologies, causal inference (observational and experimental), and modern data stack tools (Python, R, SQL), alongside a deep theoretical understanding of econometrics and mechanism design.
* **Marketplace Intuition** with a proven track record of working with large-scale transactional or platform data to analyze micro-level user behavior and isolate its impact on long-term outcomes and platform health.
* **Executive Communication & Leadership** skills to distill high-dimensional economic problems into succinct, actionable narratives for non-technical executive audiences.
* **An Advanced Degree** (Master's or PhD) in Economics, Econometrics, Quantitative Finance, Statistics, Operations Research, Physics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Claims & AI Billing
jobs.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. **About the Role**

Running a healthcare practice is hard. It's a highly regulated, low-margin business. Practices deliver care upfront, then have to navigate a complex insurance system to get paid. Much of that work is manual, and it isn't always clear which claims or tasks are worth tackling first. When a practice can't operate efficiently, patients are impacted through reduced access to care or unexpected out-of-pocket costs.

Our Claims team builds software that helps clinics and hospitals get paid for the care they deliver. We build automations that can be configured to fit each practice's needs, ensuring their entire business pipeline functions smoothly.

We also build tools that help billers and administrators figure out where their time will have the biggest impact. We help them go after the highest ROI work first, work claims in bulk, and spot trends early that need their attention. We're also building AI agents as coworkers that can take on work between fixed automations and fully manual workflows and make customer onboarding and billing setup more accurate and automated. The end goal is to help clinics and hospitals work more efficiently and collect more of the revenue they've earned.

You'll own important projects and subsystems, make thoughtful technical decisions, and help us solve the right problems for the people working through claims every day. Our scope is broad: you might build a CDC pipeline, design an API, or create a new automation workflow on any given day.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll own multi-component projects where requirements may be incomplete or evolving. You'll define the approach, sequence the work, anticipate failure modes, and own problems from the first conversation through launch and beyond. This role is for someone who likes working with messy real-world data, cares about the people using their software, is looking for high levels of ownership, and enjoys turning a complicated problem into something useful.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Industrial Edge Software
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

We are the team behind the software that runs our fleet of Tesla’s utility-scale battery energy storage sites. Our application — the Site Controller — runs at the edge on embedded Linux and orchestrates the devices on a site (batteries, power meters, and more), manages configuration and redundancy, integrates with external equipment, and reliably pushes field telemetry up to the Tesla cloud. Our software is primarily written in Golang and Rust, though other strong object-oriented languages are welcome.

We are seeking a talented, motivated, and independent engineer to join the team and contribute to meaningful pieces of that stack, from implementing features through to debugging and supporting deployments. The ideal candidate will be proficient in an object-oriented language (Go, Rust, or another strong OOP language), have solid software fundamentals, and an eagerness to keep learning in an ever-evolving environment.

 **What You'll Do**

* Design, build, and own application-layer software for the Industrial Energy Site Controller on embedded Linux — settings management, telemetry, redundancy/failover, and external communications
* Contribute to the edge/on-device telemetry software — collecting, buffering, and reliably pushing field data up to the Tesla cloud (we build the device side, not the cloud backend)
Integrate the Site Controller with external, non-Tesla systems, building edge proxy/bridge services (e.g. OPC UA* CODESYS) that abstract third-party equipment behind a consistent interface
* Help build redundancy and high-availability into the site controller — failover, data/telemetry integrity, and resilient comms paths
* Partner with engineers across the Cloud/Backend, Validation/Test, Field/Deployment, and Kernel/OS teams to define integration test strategies and ship reliable software to deployed sites
* Debug issues across the stack — from application logic down through transport, including live field deployments

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Degree in Engineering (Software, Electrical, Computer Systems, or a related field), or equivalent experience
* 2-4+ years building production software; solid fundamentals in architecture, concurrency, and testing
* Proficiency in Go, Rust, or another strong object-oriented language; experience with (or strong interest in) developing applications on embedded Linux
* Experience integrating with industrial/utility protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, DNP3, SCADA, CAN) — or a demonstrated ability to pick up unfamiliar external protocols quickly
* Experience building on-device/edge data collection and ingestion on resource-constrained systems — reliable buffering and delivery to a backend over unreliable field networks (or strong adjacent experience and a willingness to learn)
* Experience with (or strong interest in) designing for redundancy, failover, and fault tolerance in distributed or field-deployed systems

**About the Role**
------------------

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own Commure's data warehouse platform end-to-end. You'll design, build, and operate every layer of the stack:

* CDC pipelines
* Streaming transport
* Schema governance and data contracts
* Query and serving layer
* Analytics platform

The core stack today: Debezium for CDC, StarRocks as our MPP query and serving engine, and dbt for transformation and modeling. This is a hands-on IC role with broad scope. You'll make architectural calls, write the code that matters most, and establish the patterns and conventions on the data platform.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the data warehouse platform end-to-end: CDC pipelines, data lake, query layer, transformation layer, and the analytics-facing tooling that sits on top.
* Design and operate CDC pipelines with Debezium (and Kafka, Redpanda, or an equivalent streaming backbone) that move data from operational databases into the warehouse with low latency and high fidelity.
* Architect the data lake on object storage using an open table format (Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi) with Parquet, enabling both batch and streaming workloads and clean separation of storage from compute.
* Run and scale StarRocks (or adjacent MPP/lakehouse engines) as the query and serving layer - schema design, materialized views, ingestion patterns, tuning, and cost/performance trade-offs.
* Build the transformation layer with dbt: modeling standards, tests, documentation, and a semantic layer that gives every team a single source of truth for metrics.
* Stand up orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, or similar) and the CI/CD, observability, and data-quality tooling that make the platform trustworthy day-to-day.
* Partner with Security and Compliance on PHI/PII handling, access controls, lineage, and auditability so the platform meets HIPAA and SOC 2 bar by default.
* Collaborate with product and analytics teams on schema contracts, ingestion patterns, and self-serve tooling so they can build on the platform with confidence.

**What You Have**
-----------------

* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time building or operating data platforms at scale.
* Experience across the modern data stack: CDC (Debezium or equivalent), streaming (Kafka, Redpanda), data lake formats (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi), an MPP or lakehouse query engine (StarRocks, ClickHouse, Trino, Snowflake, Databricks), and dbt.
* Fluent in SQL, schema design, query optimization, and reasoning about cost and latency trade-offs on large datasets.
* Experience running production data infrastructure (orchestration, observability, on-call, data quality, and incident response).

### **Preferred**

* Direct experience with Debezium, StarRocks, and dbt in production.
* Experience building semantic layers (dbt Semantic Layer, Cube) or data catalogs / lineage (DataHub, OpenMetadata, Amundsen).
* Experience with HIPAA-regulated data (PHI handling, de-identification, and access governance).
* Experience powering AI/ML workloads: feature stores, training-set curation, embedding pipelines, or retrieval systems.
* Experience across multiple clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi) and Kubernetes controllers.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Manipulation)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

General Motors is reimagining automation at economy scale to make manufacturing more competitive in the USA.

You are a Senior Software Engineer who has deep experience in building manipulation planning and control libraries. The work covers collision-free motion generation, trajectory optimization, and the execution layer that turns a planned motion into repeatable movement on real arms.

The target applications are C++, Python, and ROS 2 on FANUC arms and mobile manipulators, under cycle time and reliability requirements. You have the taste to see important problems, the talent to build great solutions and the grit to get it done.

This role sits in the core robotics team and works alongside controls and perception engineers.

**The Opportunity**

* Build and own manipulation planning capability: collision-free planning, trajectory optimization, and time parameterization.

* Implement and tune planners for the target applications, with cycle time as a first-class requirement.

* Build the collision environment representation from perception output and static scene models.

* Implement Cartesian and constrained motion planning for approach, grasp, and place phases.

* Handle the mobile manipulation cases: planning with base placement, redundancy resolution, and whole-body motion.

* Build the execution layer that monitors trajectory tracking and reacts to deviation and contact.

* Define the interface between perception, planning, and control, and keep it clean as the system grows.

Diagnose planning failures from field data and turn them into regression cases.  



**The Job Requirements**

**Experience**

* 6+ years of professional engineering experience, with 2+ years in motion planning or manipulation.

* Experience deploying manipulation planning on physical arms in a production or field setting.

Experience meeting a cycle time requirement, not only a feasibility requirement.  



**Education**

* M.S. degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

Equivalent industry experience with demonstrated simulation depth can be considered.  



**Core technical background**

* Strong grounding in motion planning: sampling-based methods, optimization-based methods, and their respective failure modes.

* Solid kinematics and dynamics: forward and inverse kinematics, redundancy resolution, singularity handling, and Jacobian methods.

* Experience with trajectory optimization and time-optimal path parameterization.

* Experience with collision checking and distance queries, including performance characteristics.

* Hands-on experience with MoveIt, OMPL, TrajOpt, Drake, or comparable frameworks.

Strong C++ plus Python. Hands-on experience with ROS or ROS 2.  



**Systems mindset**

* Ability to judge how much fidelity a given validation question requires.

Comfortable trading simulation speed against accuracy.  



**Collaboration**

* Ability to work effectively with remote teams across multiple time zones.

Treats simulation as a product with internal users.  



**Nice to have**

* Experience with FANUC arms or the FANUC controller interfaces.

* Experience with force control, impedance control, or contact-rich manipulation.

* Experience with mobile manipulation and whole-body control.

* Experience with learned or hybrid planning approaches.

Prior open-source contributions to MoveIt or the ROS manipulation ecosystem.  

  

**Compensation:** The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. It is based on what a successful applicant might be paid in accordance with applicable state laws. The compensation may not be representative for positions located outside of the California Bay Area.

  

The salary range for this role is $129,400 to $234,100. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.

  

Bonus Potential: An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance.

  

**Benefits:** GM offers a variety of health and wellbeing benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan, sickness and accident benefits, life insurance, paid vacation & holidays, tuition assistance programs, employee assistance program, GM vehicle discounts and more.





This role is based remotely, but if the selected candidate lives within a specific mile radius of a GM hub, they will be expected to report to the location three times a week {or other frequency dictated by your manager}.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** to architect and build the **PoP Control-Plane Network Services** —the software layer that manages, routes, and controls a dynamic mesh network of satellite customer terminals in real-time.

**The Role**

You will be a founding member of our next-generation PoP infrastructure team working on the **Control Plane** that orchestrates end to end connectivity across the entire network. Your work will ensure that customers maintain a highly available satellite connection between all their different end points as you build the "distributed brain" of a space-based ISP.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Architect the Control Plane:** Design and implement highly available, low-latency control plane services using microservices patterns to handle subscriber provisioning and session management.

* **Distributed Systems at Scale:** Build and maintain stateful distributed services that operate across terrestrial data centers and orbital nodes.

* **High-Throughput Database Design:** Develop and optimize database schemas (SQL, NoSQL, and Time-Series) to track billions of telemetry points.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 8+ years

* **Languages:** Expert-level proficiency in **C++** , **Rust** , or **Go** .

* **Distributed Systems:** Deep experience with consensus algorithms ( **Raft, Paxos** ), distributed caching, and message brokers (Kafka, gRPC).

**Preferred Skills (Microservices & Distributed Systems Focus)**

* **Cloud-Native Architecture:** Extensive experience designing and deploying **microservices architectures** within containerized environments using **Kubernetes** (EKS/AKS or bare-metal).

* **Service Mesh & Discovery:** Proven track record with service mesh technologies (e.g., **Istio, Linkerd** ) and service discovery mechanisms in highly dynamic, multi-region environments.

* **Resiliency Patterns:** Expert knowledge of distributed system patterns including **circuit breakers, retries with exponential backoff, and bulkhead isolation** to ensure "five-nines" availability.

* **Event-Driven Design:** Experience building reactive, asynchronous systems using event-sourcing or CQRS patterns to manage high-velocity network state changes.

* **Observability at Scale:** Familiarity with high-cardinality monitoring and tracing (e.g., **Prometheus, Jaeger, OpenTelemetry** ) to debug complex distributed interactions across orbital and ground segments.

jobs.title: Software Engineer — Developer Platform
jobs.description:
**Cobalt Assembly**

*Build, ship, and operate software with confidence.*

**Headquarters:** San Francisco, California  
**Industry:** Cloud infrastructure and developer tools

Cobalt Assembly develops a cloud platform that helps engineering teams build, deploy, monitor, and operate production software. Its customers include technology companies and large digital businesses that need reliable infrastructure without forcing every development team to manage complex cloud systems independently.

The company is recognized for technically demanding work, a high engineering bar, and products designed primarily for professional software developers.

**Software Engineer — Developer Platform**

**Location:** San Francisco, California  
**Work arrangement:** Hybrid — four office days, with Friday available for remote work  
**Employment:** Full-time, salaried and exempt  
**Schedule:** Monday through Friday  
**Hours:** Approximately 40–45 hours per week  
**Base salary:** $180,000–$220,000, depending on experience, skills, and interview level  
**Annual cash bonus:** Not offered for this position  
**Equity:** Initial grant valued at approximately $160,000–$320,000 over four years  
**Estimated annualized compensation:** $220,000–$300,000 at the initial grant-date equity value  
**Reports to:** Engineering Manager, Developer Platform  
**On-call:** Approximately one week every ten weeks

The role

Cobalt Assembly is hiring a Software Engineer to build the tools and services that other engineering teams use to develop, test, deploy, and monitor production applications.

You will work on internal APIs, deployment workflows, developer tooling, and shared cloud infrastructure. This is a mid-level individual-contributor position with ownership of meaningful projects, but it does not include direct reports.

What you’ll do

* Build services and APIs that support application deployment, configuration, and production operations.
* Improve developer workflows from local development through testing and release.
* Design reliable systems for service discovery, permissions, deployment history, and configuration management.
* Work with product engineers to identify recurring development problems and turn them into reusable platform capabilities.
* Improve platform observability, automated testing, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Investigate production incidents and implement changes that prevent similar failures.
* Review code and technical proposals from engineers across the company.
* Participate in architecture discussions and document important technical decisions.
* Join the platform on-call rotation after completing onboarding and readiness training.

What we’re looking for

* At least three years of professional software engineering experience.
* Production experience with Go, Java, Python, TypeScript, or another modern programming language.
* Experience building backend services, APIs, or internal developer tools.
* Working knowledge of relational databases and distributed-system fundamentals.
* Understanding of testing, code review, version control, and continuous delivery.
* Ability to diagnose problems using logs, metrics, traces, and production data.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Experience owning a project from initial design through production release.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related discipline is helpful but not required.

Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, CI/CD systems, or developer-platform engineering is helpful but not required.

Technology

The platform primarily uses Go, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, and AWS. Candidates do not need experience with the entire stack and will receive time to learn unfamiliar components.

Compensation and equity

The base salary is determined by relevant experience, technical scope, interview performance, and internal leveling.

This position does not include an annual cash bonus. Instead, employees receive an equity grant that normally vests over four years, subject to the company’s equity plan and continued employment.

The stated equity value is calculated at the time of the grant. Its future value may increase or decrease and is not guaranteed. Equity should not be treated as cash salary.

Benefits

* **Health and wellbeing:** Company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees; dependent coverage subsidy; mental-health support; life and disability insurance.
* **Retirement and financial:** 401(k) with a 4% company match, pre-tax commuter benefits, and access to financial-planning resources.
* **Time away and family:** 20 days of annual PTO, company holidays, paid sick leave, and 16 weeks of paid parental leave.
* **Professional development:** $3,000 annual learning budget, conference support, technical mentorship, and dedicated engineering-learning days.
* **Office and work support:** Company laptop and home-office equipment, lunch on office days, commuter reimbursement, and relocation assistance when approved.

Eligibility and complete plan terms are provided in the official benefits documentation.

Schedule and on-call expectations

Most collaboration takes place between 10:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. Pacific Time. Engineers may arrange the remainder of their schedule with their manager.

After onboarding, the engineer joins an on-call rotation approximately once every ten weeks. On-call engineers respond to urgent platform incidents outside regular hours. When substantial overnight work is required, the following workday’s schedule is adjusted.

What success looks like

Within the first 90 days, you will understand the platform architecture, deliver a production contribution, and complete on-call readiness training.

Within six months, you should independently lead a platform improvement used by multiple engineering teams and demonstrate sound judgment during design reviews and production incidents.

jobs.description:
**About Nscale**
----------------

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

**About The Role**
------------------

We're hiring a **Senior Infrastructure Engineer — Operations & Reliability** to help operate and improve Nscale's OpenStack-based cloud infrastructure. You should have a passion for cloud infrastructure and open-source platforms to join our expanding System Engineering function. This role is pivotal in establishing our follow-the-sun operational model, providing critical coverage for live services during regional operational windows.

You will support live services, resolve incidents across Linux, OpenStack, networking, and virtualization, and work with infrastructure and systems engineering colleagues across time zones. The role combines hands-on operations with opportunities to automate recurring work and improve platform reliability. You will also collaborate with Fleet Management, Network Operations, and other engineering teams when issues cross system boundaries.

**What You'll Be Doing (Responsibilities)**
-------------------------------------------

* **Live Service Operations:** Monitor, triage, and resolve complex Level 2 (L2) incidents across our Unix/Linux and OpenStack cloud environments to safeguard customer SLAs.
* **Platform Support:** Provide hands-on operational support and maintenance across compute, networking, and virtualization layers, specifically focusing on **OpenStack Neutron** (SDN) and **OpenStack Ironic** (bare-metal provisioning).
* **Follow-the-Sun Coverage:** Operate effectively within a rotating shift framework to maintain seamless system reliability during US hours, collaborating and learning from EMEA team peers, paving the way for future APAC systems onboarding.
* **Knowledge Management:** Convert real-time troubleshooting insights into structural capital by creating, refining, and updating standard operating procedures (SOPs) and technical runbooks. Follow up on incidents with documented root-cause analysis and corrective action.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work with infrastructure and systems engineering colleagues and partner teams (like Fleet Management, Network Operations, etc.) to diagnose complex issues, make safe platform changes, and escalate when specialist input is needed.
* **Automation and SW Stack Evolution:** Turn recurring issues into lasting improvements through automation, monitoring, configuration changes, and collaboration with the relevant engineering teams.

**About You (Requirements)**
----------------------------

* **Linux/Unix Systems Administration:** Proven commercial experience managing and troubleshooting Linux-based infrastructure at scale.
* **OpenStack Core Competency:** Hands-on experience working with or maintaining OpenStack ecosystems in production or large-scale staging environments.
* **Virtualization Insights:** Practical exposure to hypervisors and virtualization technologies (e.g., KVM, Proxmox).
* **Analytical Triage Mindset:** A methodical, evidence-led, and analytical approach to incident investigation, performance bottlenecks, and root-cause analysis.
* **Communication & Documentation:** Excellent English communication skills, with a proactive approach to technical writing and knowledge sharing.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Exposure to cloud-native technologies and container orchestration (Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with infrastructure automation tooling (Ansible, Terraform, Python/Bash scripting).
* Experience with data-centre buildout systems, hardware lifecycle processes, or infrastructure automation.

**What We Can Offer You**
-------------------------

* Highly competitive package (base + equity) with reviews every 12 months.
* **Human-First Flexibility:** We trust Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.
* A dynamic progression plan tailored specifically to your ambitions, with explicit mentorship towards Senior Engineering paths.

The range below reflects the base salary for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related factors such as skill set, experience, education, and location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus, equity, and/or commission programs. Nscale may offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, flexible paid time off, parental leave, and retirement plan participation.

**Salary Range**

$100,000 - $180,000 USD

jobs.description:

**Machine Learning Engineers** at IMC play a pivotal role in building the systems that drive training and deployment of large-scale ML models across IMC's global operations. They collaborate with quantitative researchers, hardware specialists and software engineers to build robust systems that get the most out of GPU acceleration, distributed computing and the broader open-source ML ecosystem. ML Engineers' work directly shapes how fast we can experiment, iterate and deploy — accelerating the cycle that turns a research idea into a live trading strategy.

This is a unique opportunity to solve problems at the intersection of advanced machine learning and trading, where your contributions will shape the future of IMC's technology and trading capabilities.

As a team, our Machine Learning Engineers broadly work across two areas: **ML Research Engineering**, focused on the systems and frameworks researchers use to train, evaluate and iterate on models at scale; and **ML Performance Engineering**, focused on making ML workloads execute as efficiently as possible, typically through GPU and low-level systems optimization. These aren't rigid tracks, and there is overlap between them. You will bring depth of expertise in at least one of these focus areas and collaborate closely with global team members.

**Your Core Responsibilities**

*The responsibilities below are representative of the role — the exact mix depends on your team, area of expertise and location.*

**ML Research Engineering**

* Develop large-scale distributed training pipelines that manage complex datasets and models.
* Partner with quantitative researchers to automate ML experiments, hyperparameter tuning and model retraining.
* Work with HPC specialists to optimise workflows, improve training speed and reduce compute cost.

**ML Performance Engineering**

* Build and optimise low-latency inference pipelines, ensuring models deliver real-time predictions in production systems.
* Maximise performance in training and inference using GPU hardware and acceleration libraries.

**Across both areas**

* Extend and improve the internals of machine learning frameworks and open-source tools to raise their performance for our workloads.
* Design scalable model infrastructure capable of handling high-volume trading data and delivering real-time, high-accuracy predictions.
* Evaluate and roll out third-party tools that enhance model development, training and inference capabilities.

**Your Skills and Experience**

**Core, regardless of focus area:**

* 3+ years of experience in machine learning, with a focus on training or inference systems.
* **Production software engineering —** Python, testing discipline and genuine ownership of systems once they ship.
* **Machine learning fundamentals —** you understand modern ML workloads beyond high-level APIs and can reason about model behaviour, correctness and performance at the level relevant to your area of expertise.
* **A systems mindset —** you reach for measurement before opinion on performance, scale or reliability issues, and can make sound build-versus-buy decisions.
* **Strong collaboration —** comfortable explaining the reasoning behind your technical decisions, working through differing perspectives with researchers and adapting your approach when the evidence supports it.

**Depth in one or more of the following:**

* **Distributed training and large-scale systems —** parallelism strategy, data pipelines and checkpointing; frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or JAX.
* **GPU performance and low-level optimisation —** reasoning about memory, compute and latency at the device level, and optimising performance across kernels, compilers and hardware (e.g. CUDA, Triton or equivalent).
* **Production inference systems —** hands-on experience building and hardening real-time, low-latency prediction pipelines in high-performance environments.
* **Numerics and correctness at scale —** low-precision effects, KV caching, batching, and knowing which optimisations stay bit-exact.

*Technologies listed above are examples rather than requirements; equivalent depth developed using other stacks or hardware platforms is equally relevant.*

**Also a plus:**

* Exposure to cloud platforms and orchestration tools.
* A track record of contributing to open-source projects in machine learning, data science or distributed systems.

**Not sure this is the one?** If your strength is mainly in modelling and research direction, our Deep Learning Researcher roles are likely a closer fit. If your strength is in general infrastructure rather than ML-specific systems, take a look at our broader infrastructure engineering roles.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Advertising is seeking a Data Scientist II to help measure and improve one of the world's largest advertising identity platforms. You will work with massive datasets to uncover insights that directly influence how Amazon recognizes customers, connects identity signals, and enables advertisers to reach and measure audiences across the global advertising ecosystem.  
  
The Amazon Advertising Identity Platform (AIP) powers identity resolution across Amazon's owned and operated properties, third party publishers, and the open internet. As traditional identity signals become less available and consumer behavior spans more devices and environments, understanding the accuracy, coverage, and business impact of identity resolution has become increasingly important.  
  
As a Data Scientist II, you will develop analytical frameworks, measurement methodologies, and data driven insights to evaluate the performance of Amazon's identity graph. You will work with billions of identity signals to quantify recognition rates, graph coverage, identity accuracy, and the incremental value of deterministic and probabilistic identity resolution. Your analysis will help identify opportunities to improve advertising addressability, audience reach, campaign measurement, and revenue.  
  
You will design experiments, develop statistical models, and establish measurement frameworks to understand how identity improvements translate into better advertising outcomes. This includes evaluating the precision and recall of identity models, measuring the incremental contribution of individual identity sources, identifying gaps in identity coverage, and quantifying the commercial impact of identity investments.  
  
You will partner closely with applied scientists, software engineers, product managers, and business leaders to translate complex data into actionable recommendations. Your work will help shape technical priorities, guide investment decisions, and establish the metrics used to evaluate identity performance across Amazon Advertising.  
  
The ideal candidate has strong expertise in SQL, Python, statistical analysis, experimentation, and large scale data analytics. You should be comfortable working with complex datasets, developing rigorous measurement methodologies, and communicating findings to both technical and business audiences.  
  
This role offers the opportunity to establish how Amazon measures identity quality and business impact, influence the direction of a critical advertising platform, and apply data science to problems operating at global scale.

### **About Mecka AI**

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.  
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.  
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

**The role**

Every hour our operators work produces hours of synchronized video, robot state, and actions, and that data is a core product. You'll own the path from robot site to a searchable, trustworthy dataset that our researchers train on and our customers buy. You'll also run the infrastructure that keeps a growing, geographically spread fleet updated, monitored, and healthy.

**What you'll do**

* Own data storage and lifecycle: ingest from sites, object storage layout, retention, tiering, and cost.
* Build the catalog: episode metadata, task labels, operator and robot info, quality flags, and search, so anyone can find "all successful pick-and-place episodes on arm model X last month."
* Build automated quality checks: dropped frames, sync drift, missing streams, failed or truncated episodes.
* Build dataset export and delivery: convert raw episodes into the formats training teams and customers expect, with versioning and provenance.
* Handle data governance: access control, customer and site data agreements, privacy (faces, sensitive scenes on site), and audit trails for data we sell.
* Run fleet infrastructure: provisioning edge machines at sites, remote software deploys and rollbacks, secrets, VPN/connectivity, monitoring, and alerting.
* Keep cloud costs and bandwidth under control as data volume grows.
* Build dashboards to monitor data collection status and progress

**What we're looking for**

* 3-4 years as a data, platform, or infrastructure engineer owning production systems end to end.
* Experience with large unstructured data (video, sensor logs, images) in object storage, not only tabular warehouses.
* Strong Python and SQL; comfortable with infrastructure-as-code, containers, and CI/CD.
* You've built pipelines with real failure handling: retries, idempotency, backfills, and monitoring.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with robotics or autonomous-vehicle data, or ML training data pipelines.
* Edge fleet management: deploying to many remote Linux devices on unreliable networks.
* Experience packaging and delivering datasets to external customers.
* Familiarity with data privacy rules across multiple countries.

As traditional identity signals become less available and consumer behavior spans an increasing number of devices and environments, we are investing in new scientific approaches to build a more accurate, scalable, and privacy conscious identity graph.  
  
As a senior scientific leader, you will develop novel approaches to probabilistic identity resolution, graph neural networks (GNNs), representation learning, and large scale entity matching. You will combine deterministic identity signals from Amazon's owned and operated properties with signals from publishers, agencies, and third party identity providers to build accurate identity models across increasingly fragmented digital environments.  
  
You will define scientific direction, design and evaluate new models, and partner closely with engineering and product teams to bring research into production. Your work will directly influence advertising addressability, audience reach, campaign measurement, and billions of dollars in advertising revenue.  
  
The ideal candidate has deep expertise in applied machine learning, graph algorithms, and probabilistic modeling, with a demonstrated ability to translate scientific research into production systems. You should be comfortable operating in ambiguous problem spaces, challenging existing approaches, mentoring scientists, and influencing technical strategy across organizations.  
  
This role offers the opportunity to shape the future of identity resolution at Amazon, advance the state of the art in applied machine learning, and deliver scientific innovations with measurable impact across the global advertising industry.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
* PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
* Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.
