jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own Commure's data warehouse platform end-to-end. You'll design, build, and operate every layer of the stack:

* CDC pipelines
* Streaming transport
* Schema governance and data contracts
* Query and serving layer
* Analytics platform

The core stack today: Debezium for CDC, StarRocks as our MPP query and serving engine, and dbt for transformation and modeling. This is a hands-on IC role with broad scope. You'll make architectural calls, write the code that matters most, and establish the patterns and conventions on the data platform.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the data warehouse platform end-to-end: CDC pipelines, data lake, query layer, transformation layer, and the analytics-facing tooling that sits on top.
* Design and operate CDC pipelines with Debezium (and Kafka, Redpanda, or an equivalent streaming backbone) that move data from operational databases into the warehouse with low latency and high fidelity.
* Architect the data lake on object storage using an open table format (Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi) with Parquet, enabling both batch and streaming workloads and clean separation of storage from compute.
* Run and scale StarRocks (or adjacent MPP/lakehouse engines) as the query and serving layer - schema design, materialized views, ingestion patterns, tuning, and cost/performance trade-offs.
* Build the transformation layer with dbt: modeling standards, tests, documentation, and a semantic layer that gives every team a single source of truth for metrics.
* Stand up orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, or similar) and the CI/CD, observability, and data-quality tooling that make the platform trustworthy day-to-day.
* Partner with Security and Compliance on PHI/PII handling, access controls, lineage, and auditability so the platform meets HIPAA and SOC 2 bar by default.
* Collaborate with product and analytics teams on schema contracts, ingestion patterns, and self-serve tooling so they can build on the platform with confidence.

**What You Have**
-----------------

* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time building or operating data platforms at scale.
* Experience across the modern data stack: CDC (Debezium or equivalent), streaming (Kafka, Redpanda), data lake formats (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi), an MPP or lakehouse query engine (StarRocks, ClickHouse, Trino, Snowflake, Databricks), and dbt.
* Fluent in SQL, schema design, query optimization, and reasoning about cost and latency trade-offs on large datasets.
* Experience running production data infrastructure (orchestration, observability, on-call, data quality, and incident response).

### **Preferred**

* Direct experience with Debezium, StarRocks, and dbt in production.
* Experience building semantic layers (dbt Semantic Layer, Cube) or data catalogs / lineage (DataHub, OpenMetadata, Amundsen).
* Experience with HIPAA-regulated data (PHI handling, de-identification, and access governance).
* Experience powering AI/ML workloads: feature stores, training-set curation, embedding pipelines, or retrieval systems.
* Experience across multiple clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi) and Kubernetes controllers.

Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. jobs.description:

----------------

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

**About The Role**
------------------

We're hiring a **Senior Infrastructure Engineer — Operations & Reliability** to help operate and improve Nscale's OpenStack-based cloud infrastructure. You should have a passion for cloud infrastructure and open-source platforms to join our expanding System Engineering function. This role is pivotal in establishing our follow-the-sun operational model, providing critical coverage for live services during regional operational windows.

You will support live services, resolve incidents across Linux, OpenStack, networking, and virtualization, and work with infrastructure and systems engineering colleagues across time zones. The role combines hands-on operations with opportunities to automate recurring work and improve platform reliability. You will also collaborate with Fleet Management, Network Operations, and other engineering teams when issues cross system boundaries.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
**About Eagle**
---------------

Eagle is on a mission to re-energize the engineering profession. Every road, bridge, and building starts at an engineering firm. There are 40K+ of them in the US, and most run on software older than the engineers using it.

This legacy toolset was designed before the term "user experience" ever existed and it's demotivating, error-prone, and slow. We're embedding deep inside the firm and building the Iron Man suit for civil engineers to pull them out of this tedium and get them back to designing the future of our built environment.

Eagle was founded by Mayank Mardia (CEO), Sohum Daftary (President), and Tom Shouler, P.E. (CTO), and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

As a **Deployment Strategist**, you’ll report to Tom (CTO) and own the successful implementation of our technology within a partner’s business. You’ll be the lever to turn built software into an outcome and work across our entire team. You get a front-row seat to building a company within a problem domain that's barely been touched by AI.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own our platform deployment and maximize the value it delivers within a partner’s business
* Navigate the last mile from built software to outcome with empathy, persuasion, and excellent communication
* Separate signal from noise and bring insights back to the team to shape a better product
* Translate your learnings into runbooks that help us drive faster change with future partners

**Our Values**
--------------

* **Ask Why:** We have a beginner’s mind, incessantly ask questions, and share our success with others. We always want to know what we can be doing better.
* **Read the Room:** We read the situation and meet people where they are, whether that's a counterparty, a client, or each other. We listen first and understand how our words and actions impact one another.
* **Get on a Flight:** We have dogged persistence. We operate with a sense of urgency with our work and careers, and we want to push and be pushed.

**Potential Profiles**
----------------------

3+ years of experience in the following roles:

* **Former engineers** who are drawn towards scaling their impact in a more product-forward role (while still being able to build the 0 1 prototype on occasion)
* **Ex-consultants** who enjoy strategy but crave less red tape and more rapid and iterative implementation
* **Product managers** who want to work on ambitious problems with high-charisma, generative engineers

The list is not exhaustive. Do not limit yourself if you don't fit neatly into any of these buckets.

**Compensation**
----------------

* Competitive cash compensation ($150K–$250K depending on experience)
* Founding equity, scaled to scope

**Benefits**
------------

* **Health Insurance:** Full healthcare, medical and dental
* **Retirement:** 401(k)
* **PTO:** Flexible time off
* **Travel:** Company-paid
* **Office:** HQ in New York City

**Process**
-----------

Our process takes about 2 weeks: a conversation with Tom or Mayank, a second founder conversation, a 60-minute technical interview, followed by a work trial where you'll get to meet the rest of the team and build with us for a day.

jobs.description:
* Team:Research & Preclinical Development
* Location:Tarrytown
* Req ID:R52913
* Contract:Full time
* Work Pattern:Onsite

**The role**
------------

**Build Our Future Together**

  
  

We are seeking an experienced Clinical Bioinformatician to join the Regeneron Clinical Genomics Laboratory and lead the optimization, validation, and production support of NGS-based bioinformatics pipelines in a regulated clinical diagnostic environment. The ideal candidate will bring a proven track record in a CLIA-regulated laboratory, the ability to work independently, and strong communication skills to collaborate across scientific, operational, and leadership teams.

  
  

**When & where:**

* Work Location: Tarrytown, NY
* Hybrid: 4 days per week on site
  

  

**Discover your role:**

* NGS pipeline validation & optimization**:** Lead or co-lead analytical validation and revalidation of NGS bioinformatics pipelines for clinical assays, including germline and future disease applications. Optimize sensitivity, specificity, limit of detection, and variant allele fraction thresholds using clinical samples and in silico data sets. Define and document pipeline configurations, filtering criteria, and QC thresholds in accordance with AMP/CAP best practice guidelines and applicable CLIA, CAP, and state regulatory requirements.
* Bioinformatics tool evaluation & selection**:** Benchmark and select tools for alignment, variant calling, annotation, and quality control based on assay design, specimen type, and sequencing platform. Inform build-versus-buy decisions through technical evaluation of vendor-supplied pipeline solutions.
* Production pipeline operations**:** Oversee daily execution of validated clinical pipelines and monitor performance across sequencing runs and patient samples through QC programs and key performance indicators. Troubleshoot pipeline failures, data quality issues, and software errors; escalate complex problems to the Laboratory Director as appropriate.
* Change management & version control**:** Support pipeline updates through impact assessment, revalidation planning, and change documentation. Apply version control best practices throughout development and release to maintain traceability and regulatory compliance.
* Pipeline development support**:** Contribute to the design and development of new or updated pipelines, incorporating selected tools, containerization, and workflow orchestration.
* Data management & regulatory compliance**:** Manage genomic and patient data in accordance with applicable privacy laws and federal, state, and institutional data security policies. Maintain audit-ready records of pipelines, validation studies, software versions, and standard operating procedures. Support data integrity through verification, sample identifier management, and audit logging.
* Cost monitoring & resource management**:** Track and report cloud compute and storage usage, software license costs, and vendor tool expenditures. Flag cost trends and anomalies, identify savings opportunities that preserve clinical performance and compliance, and provide usage data and trend summaries to support leadership’s budget planning.
  

  
  

**This role requires:**

* Master's degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, or a related field. A Bachelor's degree with substantial hands-on experience in a CLIA-regulated clinical genomics or molecular diagnostics laboratory is accepted in lieu of a Master's degree.
* 2–4 years of experience in a clinical molecular diagnostics or clinical genomics laboratory, with demonstrated hands-on NGS bioinformatics pipeline validation experience in a CLIA-regulated setting
* Proven experience performing or supporting NGS bioinformatics pipeline validation in a CLIA-regulated clinical laboratory, including establishing sensitivity, specificity, limit of detection, and VAF thresholds
* Experience with short-read sequencing data from high-throughput platforms, including run-level and sample-level QC, demultiplexing, and troubleshooting data quality issues
* Hands-on experience validating, configuring, and supporting commercial or vendor-supplied secondary analysis and variant interpretation platforms in a clinical setting, including managing software updates, settings, and filtering criteria
* Working knowledge of NGS file formats (FASTQ, BAM/CRAM, VCF) and standard tools for alignment, variant calling, annotation, and quality control, with the ability to benchmark vendor and open-source tools against one another
* Proficiency in Linux/Unix environments and in Python or R, including scripting for QC, data analysis, and integration or automation around vendor platforms
  

  
  

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. We’re hiring Research Engineers to join teams across Meta working at the intersection of frontier AI and real-world product impact. You’ll be embedded directly in Facebook’s ecosystem, helping reimagine core experiences and reshape how people discover content, connect with creators, and interact with each other.The work spans some of the most bold bets in applied GenAI, including:- Building the post-training, evaluation, and serving systems that turn frontier LLMs into reliable, high-quality product experiences used by billions.- Building a general-purpose agentic platform that powers a wide range of GenAI products across Facebook —enabling teams to ship faster, safer, and at scale.- Building systems that enable capacity and cost optimizations through model fine-tuning, post-training and other techniques. - Adapting and scaling these systems across Meta’s products. Why Join Us- Product LLM work at singular scale Your post-training decisions, evaluation frameworks, and serving architecture directly affect billions of daily interactions.- End-to-end ownership We don't hand off models to a separate product team. We own the loop from training data to production behavior to measurement. The impact of your work shows up in days, not quarters.- The problems are unsolved How do you evaluate open-ended conversational AI at scale? How do you fine-tune for groundedness across millions of varied creator profiles? These aren't incremental improvements, they're open research questions with immediate product consequences.- Our team is hands-on, with high autonomy, working on critical bets We're deliberately keeping this team lean and experienced. You'll have outsized influence on technical direction, not just execution.Depending on your interests and strengths, your work could span post-training pipelines (SFT, RLHF, synthetic data generation), evaluation methodology (auto-judge design, benchmark construction, human-AI calibration), production serving systems (RAG, memory, multi-modal generation), multi-agent orchestration, or E2E experience of building agentic products, - all grounded in shipping to real users at scale

* Contribute to the training of next-generation multimodal foundation models, advance their capabilities in understanding, generation, and grounding, and enable them for downstream product use-cases
* Support creative data sourcing, high-quality pre/mid/post-training data curation, and scale and optimize data pipelines for multimodal large language models (LLMs)
* Lead, collaborate, and execute on research that pushes forward the state of the art in multimodal reasoning and generation research, and prioritize research that can be directly applied to Meta’s product development

Amazon's Search team creates ML algorithms that connect customers around the world with products that delight them. This is a hands-on role for someone who pairs research with the engineering discipline to turn ideas into working systems.
  
If you want to shape the foundations of how agents remember, retrieve, plan, and act, and you enjoy the ambiguity of 0→1 work, this role is for you.
  
What You’ll Do
  
Design and build agentic frameworks from scratch, including planning, tool use, orchestration, state management, and multi-agent coordination.
  
Architect and implement memory systems for agents (short-term, long-term, episodic, and semantic), including write, consolidation, forgetting, and update strategies.

new_jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Marketplace Economics
new_jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We're on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you'll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower a global community of creators and developers to build immersive experiences and a dynamic virtual economy. Our Data Science organization sits at the heart of this mission, delivering the strategic and causal insights that power pricing, market health, and creator success across all Economy surfaces.

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to lead the methodological and strategic foundations for our Creator Economics systems. Roblox operates multiple two-sided marketplaces, from the Avatar Marketplace to in-experience economies. You will build the economic systems and measurement frameworks that inform how value flows through the platform, such as building price optimization systems, designing new rev-share models, and establishing the economics for new UGC category launches. You will serve as a technical leader driving the roadmap for our most critical developer and creator touchpoints.

Why Marketplace Economics?

* **Real-world scale:** Power millions of daily economic interactions across a complex, two-sided marketplace where millions of creators meet over 100 million daily active users.
* **Complex markets, rich signals:** Design economic systems and measurement frameworks that account for the nuances of a two-sided marketplace, social network effects, long-term user attachment, and supply response.
* **Strategic ownership:** Lead projects from scratch, translating ambiguous business and policy questions into rigorous quantitative frameworks that directly influence high-stakes company decisions on the economics of our Marketplace.
* **Impact meets innovation:** Partner with Product and Engineering to shape the future of the Roblox economy, building measurement solutions that optimize for long-term ecosystem health and growth.

You will:

* **Design Economic Systems**: Drive the structural design of creator and curator incentives, including formulating revenue-share models that foster a thriving, balanced ecosystem.
* **Master Pricing & Supply Response**: Architect models that evaluate price elasticity, marketplace clearing rates, and predict how creators (supply) respond to pricing shifts and new economic policies.
* **Spearhead UGC Category Launches**: Lead the quantitative strategy for introducing new User-Generated Content (UGC) categories, establishing the foundational economics and incentive structures needed to spark market liquidity.
* **Apply Deep Causal Inference**: Build rigorous observational and experimental causal inference solutions to isolate the true impact of market interventions on creator success and platform economics.
* **Drive Strategy**: Partner with product and engineering leaders as a primary scientific advocate, providing unbiased measurement and insights to accelerate innovation and strategic prioritization.

You have (at least some of) the following:

* **6+ years** of industry or research experience in Data Science or Economics, specifically within large-scale UGC content platforms, pricing, marketplace mechanism design, or creator economies.
* **Deep Methodological Expertise** in quantitative methodologies, causal inference (observational and experimental), and modern data stack tools (Python, R, SQL), alongside a deep theoretical understanding of econometrics and mechanism design.
* **Marketplace Intuition** with a proven track record of working with large-scale transactional or platform data to analyze micro-level user behavior and isolate its impact on long-term outcomes and platform health.
* **Executive Communication & Leadership** skills to distill high-dimensional economic problems into succinct, actionable narratives for non-technical executive audiences.
* **An Advanced Degree** (Master's or PhD) in Economics, Econometrics, Quantitative Finance, Statistics, Operations Research, Physics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.

For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

We are the team behind the software that runs our fleet of Tesla’s utility-scale battery energy storage sites. Our application — the Site Controller — runs at the edge on embedded Linux and orchestrates the devices on a site (batteries, power meters, and more), manages configuration and redundancy, integrates with external equipment, and reliably pushes field telemetry up to the Tesla cloud. Our software is primarily written in Golang and Rust, though other strong object-oriented languages are welcome.

We are seeking a talented, motivated, and independent engineer to join the team and contribute to meaningful pieces of that stack, from implementing features through to debugging and supporting deployments. Integrate the Site Controller with external, non-Tesla systems, building edge proxy/bridge services (e.g. OPC UA* CODESYS) that abstract third-party equipment behind a consistent interface
* Help build redundancy and high-availability into the site controller — failover, data/telemetry integrity, and resilient comms paths

* Analytics platform

The core stack today: Debezium for CDC, StarRocks as our MPP query and serving engine, and dbt for transformation and modeling. This is a hands-on IC role with broad scope. **Systems Application Software Engineer**  
Bright Silicon Technologies | Pleasanton, CA | Full time

Bright Silicon Technologies (BST) is developing precision optical systems around our Lightfield Directing Array (LDA), a solid-state beam-steering technology. Our projects include OCTANE, a free-space laser communications terminal that brings together optics, electronics, and controls to connect moving platforms. Reliable software makes that hardware work as a system.  
  
We’re looking for a Systems Application Software Engineer with 2–5 years of experience to develop the software that operates our systems. This is a broad, hands-on engineering role spanning application development, hardware integration, communication interfaces, APIs, firmware, and testing.  
  
As part of a small engineering team, you'll work on a variety of challenges, from developing and debugging applications to implementing interfaces, integrating hardware, and validating systems in the lab. You’ll work closely with electrical, controls, communications, photonics, and other software engineers to take systems from early prototypes through production. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable working across these boundaries, eager to learn unfamiliar technologies, and ready to take ownership of engineering problems that do not always fit neatly within one discipline.

**What you’ll do**
==================

* Work hands-on with prototype systems to develop application-level software and firmware, build test suites, automate experiments, and characterize device performance.
* Systematically investigate complex hardware and software behavior, design experiments to isolate problems, identify root causes, and validate solutions.
* Translate existing algorithms into efficient, reliable software implementations.
* Develop software interfaces, APIs, telemetry systems, and application logic to control, configure, and monitor our systems.

* Take ownership of software subsystems, maintaining and improving them while collaborating with engineers across disciplines to integrate and validate the full system.

==========================

* U.S. Citizen

* Experience writing and debugging multithreaded C++ programs, with a solid understanding of pointers, memory lifetime, and data structures.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, translate ambiguous goals into well-defined solutions, and adapt to changing priorities and unfamiliar technical challenges.
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to systematically investigate problems, design experiments, isolate root causes, and validate solutions across software and hardware.

* Experience with automated hardware testing, simulation environments or digital twins, or developing tools for experimental data collection and analysis.
* Experience profiling and performance optimization on embedded systems.
* Experience with robotics, controls, communications systems, precision instrumentation, or optical systems.

* Work alongside experienced engineers in software, electronics, controls, precision mechanisms, and optics, with opportunities to learn across disciplines and expand your technical skills.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Manipulation)
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**

General Motors is reimagining automation at economy scale to make manufacturing more competitive in the USA.

You are a Senior Software Engineer who has deep experience in building manipulation planning and control libraries. The work covers collision-free motion generation, trajectory optimization, and the execution layer that turns a planned motion into repeatable movement on real arms.

The target applications are C++, Python, and ROS 2 on FANUC arms and mobile manipulators, under cycle time and reliability requirements. You have the taste to see important problems, the talent to build great solutions and the grit to get it done.

This role sits in the core robotics team and works alongside controls and perception engineers.

**The Opportunity**

* Build and own manipulation planning capability: collision-free planning, trajectory optimization, and time parameterization.

* Implement and tune planners for the target applications, with cycle time as a first-class requirement.

* Build the collision environment representation from perception output and static scene models.

* Implement Cartesian and constrained motion planning for approach, grasp, and place phases.

* Handle the mobile manipulation cases: planning with base placement, redundancy resolution, and whole-body motion.

* Build the execution layer that monitors trajectory tracking and reacts to deviation and contact.

* Define the interface between perception, planning, and control, and keep it clean as the system grows.

Diagnose planning failures from field data and turn them into regression cases.  



**The Job Requirements**

**Experience**

* 6+ years of professional engineering experience, with 2+ years in motion planning or manipulation.

* Experience deploying manipulation planning on physical arms in a production or field setting.

Experience meeting a cycle time requirement, not only a feasibility requirement.  



**Education**

* M.S. degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

Equivalent industry experience with demonstrated simulation depth can be considered.  



**Core technical background**

* Strong grounding in motion planning: sampling-based methods, optimization-based methods, and their respective failure modes.

* Solid kinematics and dynamics: forward and inverse kinematics, redundancy resolution, singularity handling, and Jacobian methods.

* Experience with trajectory optimization and time-optimal path parameterization.

* Experience with collision checking and distance queries, including performance characteristics.

* Hands-on experience with MoveIt, OMPL, TrajOpt, Drake, or comparable frameworks.

Strong C++ plus Python. Hands-on experience with ROS or ROS 2.  



**Systems mindset**

* Ability to judge how much fidelity a given validation question requires.

Comfortable trading simulation speed against accuracy.  



**Collaboration**

* Ability to work effectively with remote teams across multiple time zones.

Treats simulation as a product with internal users.  



**Nice to have**

* Experience with FANUC arms or the FANUC controller interfaces.

* Experience with force control, impedance control, or contact-rich manipulation.

* Experience with mobile manipulation and whole-body control.

* Experience with learned or hybrid planning approaches.

Prior open-source contributions to MoveIt or the ROS manipulation ecosystem.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - TeraWave PoP Control-Plane Network Services
new_jobs.description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** to architect and build the **PoP Control-Plane Network Services** —the software layer that manages, routes, and controls a dynamic mesh network of satellite customer terminals in real-time.

**The Role**

You will be a founding member of our next-generation PoP infrastructure team working on the **Control Plane** that orchestrates end to end connectivity across the entire network. Your work will ensure that customers maintain a highly available satellite connection between all their different end points as you build the "distributed brain" of a space-based ISP.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Architect the Control Plane:** Design and implement highly available, low-latency control plane services using microservices patterns to handle subscriber provisioning and session management.

The Apple Card & Savings team is building the financial products that put users in control of their money. We are looking for an experienced engineer who loves owning critical services end to end, takes pride in operational excellence, and thrives in a highly regulated environment where correctness, reliability, and compliance requirements shape every technical decision.
  
  
Description
  
  
You'll design, build, test, deliver, and operate the distributed services that power Apple Card and Savings — from applications, accounts, and transactions to payments, savings transfers, rewards, and customer notifications. You'll be given the support of a talented team, access to modern technologies, and the autonomy to take full ownership of your work. Our team operates as DevOps: we build what we run. You'll be hands-on in every phase of the lifecycle — shipping changes safely through automated pipelines and controlled rollouts, participating in an on-call rotation, joining incident response and post-incident reviews, and automating away operational toil. You'll build reliable integrations with financial institution and payment network partners and with other Apple services such as Wallet, Apple Cash, and iCloud. As an experienced member of the team, you'll own features from specification through production, review code, contribute to technical design, write clear documentation, and help onboard and mentor teammates. Success in this role requires self-motivation, clear communication, a collaborative approach, and a commitment to engineering excellence and continuous improvement.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* Solid experience building and operating production distributed systems, including services you have supported on call.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including idempotency, retries, timeouts, and consistency trade-offs.
* Proficiency in a modern backend programming language (e.g. Kotlin, Java).
* Experience debugging production issues using logs, metrics, and traces, and following through on fixes and post-incident improvements.
* A testing-first mindset: experience writing thorough unit and integration tests as a natural part of development, and designing code with testability in mind.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical issues to non-engineering stakeholders and external partners.

* Experience using generative AI tools throughout the software development lifecycle to produce high-quality software.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Production experience with Kotlin and Spring at high transaction volumes, including tuning JVM performance, managing connection pools, and maintaining API contracts across multiple concurrent client versions.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform
new_jobs.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own Commure's data warehouse platform end-to-end. You'll design, build, and operate every layer of the stack:

* CDC pipelines
* Streaming transport
* Schema governance and data contracts
* Query and serving layer
* Analytics platform

The core stack today: Debezium for CDC, StarRocks as our MPP query and serving engine, and dbt for transformation and modeling. This is a hands-on IC role with broad scope. You'll make architectural calls, write the code that matters most, and establish the patterns and conventions on the data platform.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the data warehouse platform end-to-end: CDC pipelines, data lake, query layer, transformation layer, and the analytics-facing tooling that sits on top.
* Design and operate CDC pipelines with Debezium (and Kafka, Redpanda, or an equivalent streaming backbone) that move data from operational databases into the warehouse with low latency and high fidelity.
* Architect the data lake on object storage using an open table format (Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi) with Parquet, enabling both batch and streaming workloads and clean separation of storage from compute.
* Run and scale StarRocks (or adjacent MPP/lakehouse engines) as the query and serving layer - schema design, materialized views, ingestion patterns, tuning, and cost/performance trade-offs.
* Build the transformation layer with dbt: modeling standards, tests, documentation, and a semantic layer that gives every team a single source of truth for metrics.
* Stand up orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, or similar) and the CI/CD, observability, and data-quality tooling that make the platform trustworthy day-to-day.
* Partner with Security and Compliance on PHI/PII handling, access controls, lineage, and auditability so the platform meets HIPAA and SOC 2 bar by default.
* Collaborate with product and analytics teams on schema contracts, ingestion patterns, and self-serve tooling so they can build on the platform with confidence.

**What You Have**
-----------------

* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time building or operating data platforms at scale.
* Experience across the modern data stack: CDC (Debezium or equivalent), streaming (Kafka, Redpanda), data lake formats (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi), an MPP or lakehouse query engine (StarRocks, ClickHouse, Trino, Snowflake, Databricks), and dbt.
* Fluent in SQL, schema design, query optimization, and reasoning about cost and latency trade-offs on large datasets.
* Experience running production data infrastructure (orchestration, observability, on-call, data quality, and incident response).

### **Preferred**

* Direct experience with Debezium, StarRocks, and dbt in production.
* Experience building semantic layers (dbt Semantic Layer, Cube) or data catalogs / lineage (DataHub, OpenMetadata, Amundsen).
* Experience with HIPAA-regulated data (PHI handling, de-identification, and access governance).
* Experience powering AI/ML workloads: feature stores, training-set curation, embedding pipelines, or retrieval systems.
* Experience across multiple clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi) and Kubernetes controllers.

Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

Employees will act in accordance with the organization’s information security policies, to include but not limited to protecting assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference nor execute particular security processes or activities. Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.

Compensation Range: $180K - $230K

* **Communication & Documentation:** Excellent English communication skills, with a proactive approach to technical writing and knowledge sharing.

----------------

* Exposure to cloud-native technologies and container orchestration (Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with infrastructure automation tooling (Ansible, Terraform, Python/Bash scripting).

**What We Can Offer You**
-------------------------

* Highly competitive package (base + equity) with reviews every 12 months.

In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus, equity, and/or commission programs. $100,000 - $180,000 USD

new_jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
new_jobs.description:
**About Eagle**
---------------

Eagle is on a mission to re-energize the engineering profession. Every road, bridge, and building starts at an engineering firm. There are 40K+ of them in the US, and most run on software older than the engineers using it.

This legacy toolset was designed before the term "user experience" ever existed and it's demotivating, error-prone, and slow. We're embedding deep inside the firm and building the Iron Man suit for civil engineers to pull them out of this tedium and get them back to designing the future of our built environment.

Eagle was founded by Mayank Mardia (CEO), Sohum Daftary (President), and Tom Shouler, P.E. (CTO), and is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

As a **Deployment Strategist**, you’ll report to Tom (CTO) and own the successful implementation of our technology within a partner’s business. You’ll be the lever to turn built software into an outcome and work across our entire team. You get a front-row seat to building a company within a problem domain that's barely been touched by AI.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own our platform deployment and maximize the value it delivers within a partner’s business
* Navigate the last mile from built software to outcome with empathy, persuasion, and excellent communication
* Separate signal from noise and bring insights back to the team to shape a better product
* Translate your learnings into runbooks that help us drive faster change with future partners

**Our Values**
--------------

* **Ask Why:** We have a beginner’s mind, incessantly ask questions, and share our success with others. We always want to know what we can be doing better.
* **Read the Room:** We read the situation and meet people where they are, whether that's a counterparty, a client, or each other. We listen first and understand how our words and actions impact one another.
* **Get on a Flight:** We have dogged persistence. We operate with a sense of urgency with our work and careers, and we want to push and be pushed.

**Potential Profiles**
----------------------

3+ years of experience in the following roles:

* **Former engineers** who are drawn towards scaling their impact in a more product-forward role (while still being able to build the 0 1 prototype on occasion)
* **Ex-consultants** who enjoy strategy but crave less red tape and more rapid and iterative implementation
* **Product managers** who want to work on ambitious problems with high-charisma, generative engineers

The list is not exhaustive. Do not limit yourself if you don't fit neatly into any of these buckets.

**Compensation**
----------------

* Competitive cash compensation ($150K–$250K depending on experience)
* Founding equity, scaled to scope

**Benefits**
------------

* **Health Insurance:** Full healthcare, medical and dental
* **Retirement:** 401(k)
* **PTO:** Flexible time off
* **Travel:** Company-paid
* **Office:** HQ in New York City

**Process**
-----------

Our process takes about 2 weeks: a conversation with Tom or Mayank, a second founder conversation, a 60-minute technical interview, followed by a work trial where you'll get to meet the rest of the team and build with us for a day.
